        Backup and restore
        
    
        
      
        Back up your library
        
      
        Everything you add is kept on this device only. A backup is one .zip file. Save it somewhere safe, or open it on your phone to move your library there.
        
      
        
      
        
      
      
      
        
      
        
      
      
        
    
        
    
        
      
        Restore from a backup
        
      
        Choose a backup file made by this app, like one you made on your tablet. It adds everything in the file to this library. Anything already here with the same identity is updated.
        
      
        
      
      
        
        
        
        
        
          
          
        
        
      
        
      
      
        
    
        
    
        Library tools
        
    
        
      Library tools: import and export
      
        
      
        Import a title list
        
      
        Choose a .json or .csv file. You will see a preview first, and nothing is saved until you tap Import. Columns used: title, category (BL or Romance), status, chapter, total, bookmark, readLater, tags. Covers cannot be imported from a list.
        
      
        
      
      
        Import preview
        
      
        Export your title list
        
      
        
      
        The full backup with covers and chapters is in the More tab.
        
      
        
    
        
    
        Tools
        
    
        
      Test tools (panel review, line viewer)
      
        These open the panel review and the line 76 viewer. They used to float over the bottom buttons.

        About
        
    
        
      
        Ookami Hana 狼花
        
      
        Wolf Flower. Turns manhwa chapters into narrated videos with free voices that run on this device.
        
      
        
      
        Version: Stage 24A (installable app), Voice speed test and experimental faster voice in More. Voices: Kokoro (free, on-device), your own recordings, and browser voices.
        
      
        Name helper: waiting.

        Characters, voices and casting
        
          Add the main characters and pick their voices. Everyone else the app finds gets a voice automatically. These characters belong to the manhwa you picked.
          

    
          
      
          Add a character
          
      
      
      
      
          
      
          
        Paste several names at once
        
          One character per line. Just the name is fine. You can add the type after commas, in any order: main or side, man or woman. Example: Roella Brieta, main, woman. Names you already have are skipped, and nothing existing is changed.
          
        
        
        
          
      
          
    
          

    
          
      Try the free voices before you pick one
      
          Every voice says the same words, so you can compare them. You can change the words. The first time you hear a voice it downloads a tiny file (about half a megabyte), then it plays. Ratings come from the people who made the model and are only a rough guide to how well each voice was trained. They are not a listening test, so trust your own ears.
          
      
      
          
      
          
    
          

    
          
      Voice casting: free voices by importance
      
          Pick which free voices suit each group of characters. Tap the x to remove a voice from a group, or add another. You can still give any voice to any character on their own card. "Suggest voices" only ever fills characters who have no free voice yet. It asks first, shows you a list to review, and changes nothing until you press Apply.

        Dialogue scanning and review
        
            
          
            Free scanner (runs on this device)
            
          
            Reads the words on the pages with a free open-source engine (PaddleOCR.js). No Claude, no account, no payment. The page pictures stay on this device. It reads text only: you choose who says each line, and nothing is saved to the chapter until you approve it. Scanning is optional; you can make videos without it.
            
          
            Downloads, data use and limits
            
            First use downloads files. The scanner code (from esm.sh or jsDelivr, version 0.4.2) and two model files (from the PaddleOCR project) are fetched over HTTPS. Expect roughly 30 MB or more in total: about 10 MB of image-processing code and about 15 MB for the engine (sizes taken from the packages), plus the two model files (size not measured). Use Wi-Fi if you can. The model files are kept in this browser\u2019s storage so later scans do not download them again. Use \u201cDelete downloaded scanner files\u201d to remove them.
            
            
            Limits. It works best on clear, printed English text. Small, stylised, handwritten or very busy text may be misread: lines it is unsure about are marked Unclear. It cannot tell who is speaking, so speakers start as Unknown, and every line starts as Spoken until you change it. It runs on the phone itself, so a page can take a while, and the screen may feel slow while it works. Always scan the test pages first.
            
            
            If it will not load (no internet, blocked hosts, not enough memory), you get a message and can type lines by hand, or use Paste a script in step 5.
            
          
            
          
            
          
            
          
        
            
        
            Claude reads the speech bubbles and works out who is talking. This uses your own Claude usage, and the first time you will be asked to allow it. Longer chapters take longer.
            
        
        
        
        
            
          
          
        
            
        
        
            

      
            Check the lines
            
      
            Check that each line has the right character. Add an audio file to a line to give it a voice, or use Hear to check it with a built-in voice.
            
      
            
      
            
      
      
      
      
            
      
            

      
            
        Generate, review and reuse audio
        
            Open a chapter's audio screen to make every missing voice with the free voices, check them, replace one, or add your own recording. Lines that already have audio are kept and never made twice. You can also add, play or remove the audio of a single line in the line cards in step 4.
            
        
            Select chapters in step 2 first.
            
        
              
        
              
      
              

      
              
        Video settings and creation
      
              Each chapter has its own video settings (direction, speed and sounds). Open them with the button on its row, then make the videos. This makes a video for each chapter below, one after another, using its lines, voices, and sounds. Keep this screen on and stay in the app until it finishes.
              
      
              None of your ticked chapters have audio yet. Add audio in step 5 first.

        Pan direction
        
                    
          
          
        
                    
      
                    
      
      
      
      
                    A smaller gap size finds more cuts. A faster pan makes each scene shorter. Each scene lasts as long as its spoken lines, plus the pause between lines.
